lessonTitle: The evolution of Medical Affairs: from scientific support to strategic partner

slides.title: Medical Affairs Began as a Reactive Back Office
bullets: Answered unsolicited medical questions
Reviewed promotional materials for scientific accuracy
Supported regulatory dossiers
Success measured by absence of problems, not positive contribution

slides.title: Three Forces Reshaped the Function
bullets: Specialty, biologic and gene therapies demand deeper scientific dialogue
Payers now demand real-world outcomes data pivotal trials can't provide
Pricing pressure made scientific differentiation a key value lever

slides.title: CEO-Reporting Nearly Doubled in Four Years
slides.caption: A concrete marker of Medical Affairs' rising strategic weight — McKinsey / MAPS analysis

slides.title: From Support Function to Strategic Partner
bullets: MAPS describes Medical Affairs as entering a "third era"
Compliance support, then scientific engagement, now strategic partner
Leadership co-designs launch strategy and evidence plans from early development

slides.title: Reactive Waits; Strategic Anticipates
bullets: Reactive professionals wait for questions and answer them accurately
Strategic professionals anticipate evidence gaps before they become urgent
They structure field insights so they actually change internal decisions
They can explain impact in a boardroom, not just a scientific exchange

slides.title: Local Strategic Positioning Drives Influence
bullets: AstraZeneca Spain case documented in scientific literature
Teams that understood the local healthcare ecosystem well
Positioned as strategic partners, not just field scientific responders
Achieved measurably greater organisational influence

slides.title: The Bar Has Moved for MSLs
bullets: Scientific accuracy and compliance are the floor, not the ceiling
Advancement to Medical Advisor, Lead and Director rewards strategic thinking
Connect field insight to the medical plan and to patient outcomes

takeaway.title: Medical Affairs evolved from a reactive support function into a strategic partner that co-designs launch and evidence strategy
bullets: Three forces drove the shift: complex products, payer demands, pricing pressure
CEO-reporting for Medical Affairs leaders nearly doubled between 2019 and 2023
Career advancement now rewards strategic thinking, not just scientific accuracy
